CT1.answer:

| UBS | 8 Jul 2025 | Not disclosed | $175 | **Not measurable** from the available UBS report | Buy [UBS Research, 2025-07-08, p.1] |
| Barclays | 25 Sep 2025 | $200 | $240 | **+$40 / +20.0%** | Overweight [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |
| **Barclays cumulative** | Jun–Sep 2025 | $170 | $240 | **+$70 / +41.2%** | — [Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1; Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

**Comparison:** Barclays raised its NVDA target twice, cumulatively from **$170 to $240**. The corpus contains only one UBS target—**$175 on 8 July**—so UBS’s target change cannot be established. At that date, Barclays’ latest documented target was **$200**, or **$25 higher** than UBS’s.

CT2.answer:
**Coverage note:** The knowledge base covers Barclays reports from **June 12 to September 29, 2025**, not the full calendar year.

| Report date | NVDA price target | Prior target | Change | Rating |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Jun. 17, 2025 | **$200** | $170 | **+18%** | Overweight, unchanged [Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1] |
| Aug. 13, 2025 | No NVDA target update—the report was a broader AI-power thematic note [Barclays, 2025-08-13, p.1] |
| Sep. 25, 2025 | **$240** | $200 | **+20%** | Overweight, unchanged [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

Barclays therefore moved its NVDA target from **$170 before the June report to $200 in June and $240 in September**. That is a cumulative **$70, or roughly 41%, increase**, while retaining its **Overweight** rating. The June increase reflected confidence in second-half Blackwell-related upside; the September increase followed Barclays’ estimate of more than **$2 trillion** in planned AI infrastructure spending, much of which it expected to flow through NVDA’s P&L [Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1] [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1].

RQ1.answer:
本知识库仅覆盖 **2025年6月12日至9月29日**，并非完整过去两年；因此以下比较只反映该窗口内的研报轨迹。

| 券商 | 日期 | 评级 | 目标价 | 前次目标价 | 调整 |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 巴克莱 | 2025-06-17 | 增持（Overweight） | **$200** | $170 | **上调17.6%**（报告列示18%）[Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1] |
| UBS | 2025-07-08 | 买入（Buy） | **$175** | 未披露 | 该报告没有显示目标价调整[UBS Research, 2025-07-08, p.1] |
| 巴克莱 | 2025-09-25 | 增持（Overweight） | **$240** | $200 | **上调20%**[Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

**区别很明显：**

- **巴克莱呈连续、进取式上调**：目标价从 **$170→$200→$240**，覆盖期内累计提高 **$70、约41%**。6月上调主要基于下半年供应链与Blackwell放量带来的业绩上行；9月则进一步基于AI算力部署和计划支出的扩张。[Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1] [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1]
- **UBS在库内只有一个可观察点**：7月目标价为 **$175**，低于巴克莱当时的$200；由于没有前值或后续UBS报告，无法从现有资料判断其是否上调，以及完整的调整路径。[UBS Research, 2025-07-08, p.1]

因此，在实际可覆盖窗口内，**巴克莱明显更积极且多次上调；UBS则只能确认维持在较保守的$175观察值，不能据此还原两年轨迹。**

RQ2.answer:
*Available Barclays coverage is from June 12 to September 29, 2025.*

| Report date | Rating | Price-target revision | Increase | Implied upside at publication |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Jun. 17, 2025 | Overweight, unchanged | **$170 → $200** | **18%** | 38.2% [Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1] |
| Sep. 25, 2025 | Overweight, unchanged | **$200 → $240** | **20%** | 35.6% [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

**Yes—Barclays has been getting more bullish.** It raised Nvidia’s target twice in roughly three months, from $170 to $240—a cumulative **$70, or 41%** increase—while retaining its Overweight rating.

The rationale also strengthened:

- **June:** better second-half supply-chain builds, higher compute estimates and confidence in Blackwell/Blackwell Ultra drove the move to $200 [Barclays, 2025-06-17, p.1].
- **September:** Barclays estimated more than **$2T of planned AI infrastructure spending**, with roughly 65–70% attributable to compute and networking, and expected much of that opportunity to flow through Nvidia over five-plus years [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1].

One nuance: implied upside slipped from 38.2% to 35.6% despite the higher target because Nvidia’s share price had risen substantially between the reports. Thus, the **fundamental view became more bullish**, even though point-in-time forecast upside remained broadly mid-to-high 30%.

RQ3.answer:
> **数据边界：**资料库截至 **2025年9月29日**，并非实时行情。巴克莱最新涉及英伟达的公司研究发布于 **2025年9月25日**，采用 **9月24日**收盘价。

| 巴克莱最新判断 | 数值 |
|---|---:|
| 评级 | **增持（Overweight），维持不变** [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |
| 目标价 | **240美元/股**，由200美元上调20% [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |
| 参考股价（2025-09-24） | **176.97美元/股** [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |
| 目标价隐含上涨空间 | **35.6%** [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |
| 当时市值 | **约4.30万亿美元** [Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1] |

**巴克莱的核心看法：**英伟达是其半导体覆盖中“最具吸引力”的公司。巴克莱追踪到约 **2万亿美元**的已规划AI基础设施投入、约 **40GW**电力需求，其中约 **65%–70%**预计投向计算与网络；这使英伟达提出的 **3万亿–4万亿美元**长期机会看起来更可信。巴克莱认为相关支出未来五年以上将主要流入英伟达损益表，因此把目标价上调至240美元。[Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1]

**一句话结论：**按巴克莱最新报告，英伟达当时市值约 **4.3万亿美元**，但其认为股票合理目标价为 **240美元**，仍有约 **36%**上行空间。[Barclays, 2025-09-25, p.1]
